feedback.schema.json.observed_behavior: The weekly review requires copying decisions from several tools.
hypotheses: A source-backed decision view may reduce reconciliation.

initiative.schema.json.title: Source-backed decision view
initiative.schema.json.problem: Teams manually reconcile decisions across tools.
initiative.schema.json.intended_outcome: A user can review current decisions with provenance in one place.
success_measures: A user completes a weekly review without a manual copy step.

experiment.schema.json.title: Test decision-view prototype
experiment.schema.json.hypothesis: A consolidated view cuts weekly preparation time.
experiment.schema.json.method: Observe three users completing the same review with and without the prototype.
experiment.schema.json.success_threshold: Median preparation time falls by at least 30%.
